findings.desc: concept-cleanup: new command verification_pin_guard_check was added to command-policy.ts (readOnly gate for the B-1507 evidence-pin hook) but has NO entry in process-fact-levels.ts PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS. packages/main/src/tasks/lifecycle-registry-contract.ts checkProcessFactLifecycle() asserts every command-policy command has a process-fact level entry; this contract task is registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands, i.e. it runs as part of lattice validate. Verified by direct execution: node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-registry-contract.js on this branch prints lifecycle-registry consistency: FAIL with [process-fact-lifecycle] command verification_pin_guard_check is in the registry command dimension (command-policy) but has no process-fact lifecycle level entry. Same task built from main PASSes with 0 divergences (main has no verification_pin_guard_check string in process-fact-levels.ts at all), confirming this is a regression introduced by this diff. verification_run (the other new command in this story) IS correctly present in process-fact-levels.ts/process-fact-registry.ts, and its sibling readOnly guard prewrite_guard_check IS present in process-fact-levels.ts at L0 -- so the omission is specific to verification_pin_guard_check. Fix: add a PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS entry for verification_pin_guard_check (e.g. level L0, category guard-session-read, matching the prewrite_guard_check precedent).
findings.resolvedReason: eae5eba: registered verification_pin_guard_check in process-fact-levels.ts (L0, guard-session-read); registry auto-derives from PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS. Verified lifecycle-registry-contract PASS (was FAIL), red-evidence-target-binding OK.

findings.desc: concept-cleanup: half-wired host parity for the new fail-open evidence-pin PreToolUse hook (CHK-003, promised on both hosts, Claude Bash side described as fully asserted). init-assets.ts getClaudeHooks() was updated to add a 3rd PreToolUse entry (matcher=Bash -> lattice-evidence-pretool.cjs), and the parallel LIVE Codex asset .codex/hooks.json in this repo WAS regenerated/committed in this same diff to add its matcher entry (shell|local_shell|exec_command -> lattice-evidence-pretool.cjs). But the parallel LIVE Claude asset .claude/settings.json (git-tracked, the actual host config for this self-hosted repo) was NOT updated to add the matching Bash entry -- it still only has 2 PreToolUse entries (scope-pretool, english-only-guard). Verified mechanically: node bin/lattice.js check reports `STALE_SAFE .claude/settings.json: Proofbound Claude hooks are missing from settings.json` (action: merge missing Proofbound hook commands), and this exact STALE_SAFE reason is new/introduced by this diff -- on main, the generator (2 hooks) and settings.json (2 hooks) agree. Net effect: in this exact repo, the new evidence-pin seatbelt hook file (.claude/hooks/lattice-evidence-pretool.cjs) is present on disk but never fires for real Claude Code Bash tool calls until someone runs `lattice check --apply`/`lattice init --upgrade` and commits the result -- the CHK-003 checklist Files.modify list also omits .claude/settings.json (unlike .codex/hooks.json, which IS listed and was updated), suggesting this was an oversight rather than an intentional deferral. The real enforcement floor (enforceAndStampEvidence handler) is unaffected, but the promised early-warning seatbelt layer on the Claude host is not actually installed in this repo as shipped. Fix: run lattice check --apply (or manually merge the 3rd PreToolUse hook entry) and commit the resulting .claude/settings.json alongside this story, mirroring what was already done for .codex/hooks.json.
findings.resolvedReason: eae5eba: added the Bash matcher PreToolUse entry for lattice-evidence-pretool.cjs to .claude/settings.json byte-matching hookCommand() (surgical). Verified lattice check no longer reports the missing hook (OK=5).

findings.desc: lattice validate is NOT green for this story: packages/main/src/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:1436-1443 pins packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts to a whole-file AST fingerprint (48ca6562b1...) via PINNED_EXECUTABLE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINTS (line 362). CHK-001 modified cli-engine.ts (added the verification_run entry to MILESTONE_STATUS_APPEND_COMMANDS at line ~515), which changes the fingerprint, so the previously-approved import(`file://${initPath}`) call site in runCli() is now flagged unapproved. Reproduced deterministically: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js` FAILS with `AssertionError: the exact registered cli-engine non-literal loader call site must remain allowed`. This is not an edge case in my mutation testing -- it also failed as command 3/54 in a fresh `lattice validate --story=B-1507 --json` run, well before any experiment I ran. Fix: recompute canonicalAstFingerprint for the new cli-engine.ts content and update the PINNED_EXECUTABLE_SOURCE_FINGERPRINTS entry.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/verification-run-and-guard-smoke.ts assertion A2 (line ~189-193, `A2: exit-nonzero pin is refused`) failed ONCE inside a live `lattice validate --story=B-1507 --json` run (command 9/54, AssertionError: expected the operation to be REFUSED but it succeeded), on an otherwise-unmutated build -- i.e. lattice validate reported allPass:false partly because of this, independent of the two missing-registry findings I filed separately. I could not reproduce it: 8 sequential standalone runs, 5 runs through the exact runValidationCommand spawn path used by validate (repro script), and 6 concurrent/parallel runs (19 total) all PASSED. Per the CLAUDE.md Debugging Contract I am not claiming a root cause without a repro, but I also cannot silently drop a real exit=1 observed from a fresh validate run of this exact story/build. Flagging as a coverage/reliability gap on the RED-first smoke itself: if verification_run -> enforceAndStampEvidence has any timing sensitivity around child-process exit-code capture under load/contention, the mutation-kill guarantee for A2 is not rock solid. Recommend: rerun `lattice validate --story=B-1507` once or twice more to confirm current stability before relying on this as the sole gate for CHK-001s adversarial intent; if it recurs, that is the repro this contract requires before a fix.
